description: Structured data from a web page (url) or your own text: give a schema of up to 20 field names with what each holds, and get a JSON object with exactly those fields, null where the text does not state one. Llama 3.3 70B. Text is capped at 12,000 characters; a model answer that is not JSON is retried once, then not charged. Price: $0.004 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

instructions.description: Optional extra instructions, up to 500 characters

schema.description: Field name to what the field holds, up to 20 fields

text.description: Text to read (up to 12,000 characters), instead of url
